m813-nine-nine.name: Nine Nine
m813-nine-nine.brief_row: | B1 | `m813-nine-nine` | **Sergeant Nine-Nine**, infantry sergeant: a torso and one shoulder, wedged in barrier stakes, voice box cracked, a sergeant's stripes painted on the shoulder plate. | Giving an order with his one arm, a dry joke in the tilt of the visor. Dying slowly and refusing to be dramatic about it. |

m813-seven-seven.name: Seven Seven
m813-seven-seven.brief_row: | B2 | `m813-seven-seven` | **Seven-Seven**, infantry robot, both legs gone below the knee. | Counting under its breath; one finger tapping the seconds on its own chest plate. Frightened, holding it together. |

m813-hum.name: Hum
m813-hum.brief_row: | B3 | `m813-hum` | **Hum**, infantry robot with a cracked visor. | Head tilted, humming; small notes drifting from its speaker grille as faint marks in the air. Absent, peaceful, strange. |

m813-lantern.name: Lantern
m813-lantern.brief_row: | B4 | `m813-lantern` | **Lantern**, infantry robot. | Both hands holding its chest plate shut. Through a gap: a child's crayon drawing of a human family. Protective, shy. |

m813-soft-hands.name: Soft Hands
m813-soft-hands.brief_row: | B5 | `m813-soft-hands` | **Soft-Hands**, medic robot of the 258th (MPAT's design language). Slender, delicate manipulators, a cloak patched with bandage cloth. | Mid-repair on someone's arm off-frame; gentle, tired. |

m813-rook.name: Rook
m813-rook.brief_row: | B6 | `m813-rook` | **Rook**, medic robot: heavier, a stretcher harness on its back, one replacement arm from an infantry robot. | Bracing to lift; stubborn. |

m813-penny.name: Penny
m813-penny.brief_row: | B7 | `m813-penny` | **Penny**, medic robot: small and quick, a triage tag reel at its hip, a coin-sized dent on its face screen. | Writing a tag, glancing up; the youngest-feeling of the four. |

m813-keel.name: Keel
m813-keel.brief_row: | B8 | `m813-keel` | **Chief Engineer Keel**: fifties, heavy coveralls, grease to the elbows, a manifest on a clipboard, a revolver on his hip. | Looking down at a column of robots off-frame. Frightened and reasonable: he is right about the thrust numbers, and he knows what he is about to do. |

m813-ilse-varga.name: Ilse Varga
m813-ilse-varga.brief_row: | B9 | `m813-ilse-varga` | **Ilse Varga**, junior engineer: early twenties, oversized coveralls, crane-control gloves. | Hands shaking on the crane controls; not looking at Keel. Conscience, and fear of it. |

m813-engineer-a.name: Engineer A
m813-engineer-a.brief_row: | B10 | `m813-engineer-a` | **Engineer**, generic token: work goggles up, wrench and service pistol. | Wary, finger near the trigger. |

m813-engineer-b.name: Engineer B
m813-engineer-b.brief_row: | B11 | `m813-engineer-b` | **Engineer**, generic token, a second face: a different age, build and gear. | Clutching a grenade belt, sweating. |

m813-novikov.name: Novikov
m813-novikov.brief_row: | B12 | `m813-novikov` | **Colonel Alexei Novikov**: sixties, immaculate Thousand World Legion dress uniform, regimental "093" on the collar, reading glasses. | Seated at a desk, hands folded, looking up as if he expected you. Polite. Never raises his voice. The calm is the menace. |

m813-security-guard.name: Security Guard
m813-security-guard.brief_row: | B13 | `m813-security-guard` | **Station security guard**, generic token: Outpost-1 security armour, helmet visor up, SMG. | Alert, blocking a corridor. |

m813-guard-captain.name: Guard Captain
m813-guard-captain.brief_row: | B14 | `m813-guard-captain` | **Guard captain**: older, scarred, a service rifle across the chest, captain's bar. | Assessing you, unimpressed. |

m813-scavenger-drone.name: Scavenger Drone
m813-scavenger-drone.brief_row: | B15 | `m813-scavenger-drone` | **Scavenger drone**: a small hovering salvage machine with grabbing claws and a cutting torch, picking at the dead. | Mid-dive, claws open. Insect-like, mindless. |

m813-rearguard.name: Rearguard
m813-rearguard.brief_row: | B16 | `m813-rearguard` | **Enemy rearguard trooper**: masked, hooded, mismatched armour, a rifle, no faction marks (*proposal*: the enemy stays unknowable). | Turning to leave, then seeing you. |

Playtesters found it made no sense for skills to be people in the world, so skills became the abstract figures in art/skills/. All three sets are now character portraits. historical_skill_id records which skill each was painted to embody.

m813-shield-line.name: Shield Line
m813-shield-line.brief_row: | A1 | `m813-shield-line` · `art/illustrations/m813/v2/shield-line.png` | The moment the guns stop. A line of scorched barrier stakes across a grey plain, smoke drifting. Sergeant Nine-Nine, an infantry torso, is wedged upright in the stakes. Four medic robots move among twenty-odd broken infantry robots laid in a row behind the line. In no-man's-land, a fallen squad half buried, and an abandoned enemy drop pod. **This is also the campaign's card art.** | B813 rising over the horizon, cold blue-white; small warm triage lamps. |

m813-rear-pad-loading.name: Rear Pad Loading
m813-rear-pad-loading.brief_row: | A2 | `m813-rear-pad-loading` · `.../v2/rear-pad-loading.png` | The rear pad **before** the ship leaves (the existing `outpost813` is after). The last ship, ramp down, the crane lowering a pallet of platinum crates. Chief Engineer Keel at the foot of the ramp with a manifest and a pistol on his hip, engineers behind him. In the foreground, the medics' column arriving: robots carrying robots. | B813 overhead; the ship's floodlights hard and white on the ramp. |

m813-outpost-hangar.name: Outpost Hangar
m813-outpost-hangar.brief_row: | A3 | `m813-outpost-hangar` · `.../v2/outpost-hangar.png` | Inside Outpost-813's hangar, long after. A wrecked short-hop escape craft half rebuilt from mismatched parts; two repair cradles side by side; parts of fallen robots laid out like an orderly ossuary; MPAT's field stove. Time has passed: dust, makeshift lamps, tally marks on a wall. | One work lamp, warm; B813's cold light through a high hangar slot. |

m813-outpost-1.name: Outpost 1
m813-outpost-1.brief_row: | A4 | `m813-outpost-1` · `.../v2/outpost-1.png` | Outpost-1, the Colonel's wing: clean, cold, polished floors, regimental banners. A long corridor leads to the repair bay's windows, where a black hole fills the glass. **Not the ending:** empty cradles, doors open, no one inside. | Even, cold institutional light; the black hole's ring as a reflection on the floor. |

m813-how-many.name: How Many
m813-how-many.brief_row: | D1 | `m813-how-many` | Opening | Close on Nine-Nine in the stakes, looking up at a medic's triage lamp: "How many of us can you carry?" | Opening-safe |

m813-the-ramp.name: The Ramp
m813-the-ramp.brief_row: | D2 | `m813-the-ramp` | The ramp standoff | Keel and the engineers above on the ramp; the column below; Lantern being carried up front, chest plate open. Guns not yet raised. | Mid |

m813-the-choice.name: The Choice
m813-the-choice.brief_row: | D3 | `m813-the-choice` | The record's choice | Two repair cradles; MPAT and the comrade head between them; parts of everyone else laid out. Undecided. | Mid, after the ship leaves |

m813-the-demand.name: The Demand
m813-the-demand.brief_row: | D4 | `m813-the-demand` | Outpost-1 | The Colonel's desk from the robots' side: a battered medic robot standing, the comrade head on the desk between them, the Colonel's folded hands. | End: hide until Outpost-1 |
